services.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
services.desc: Cruise the waters! Duration 2 - 6 Hour Rentals About Experience the ultimate low country lifestyle with our Pontoon Boat Rentals on Tybee Island. extraNote: Weather & Trip Conditions: Your safety is always our top priority. · Because the Jet Ski Safari is a longer, guided adventure, weather and water conditions can change during the trip. · If weather requires us to end the Safari early after a portion of the trip has been completed, we will prorate the trip based on the portion of the experience we were able to complete. · If conditions prevent the trip from departing, our team will work with you regarding rescheduling or the appropriate refund. · Please note that failure to arrive on time may result in you missing the experience with us and no refund being issued. · Trip Protection grants the ability to cancel or rebook your trip up to 2 hours
